note: What a server sends to add a quest to the quest tracker, complete it or remove it.

fields.name: text
fields.note: A key into the client's own text for the quest. It applies to activate only.

fields.name: icon
fields.note: The quest's icon. It applies to activate only.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: Which tracker it goes in. A tracker that is full holds a new quest back until it has room.

fields.name: action
fields.note: What to do. A client ignores any other value.

1.name: complete
1.note: Announce it done for about four seconds, and take it from the tracker five seconds later.

2.name: remove
2.note: Take it from the tracker at once; a quest held back takes its place.

fields.note: A key into the client's own text for its reward. It applies to activate only.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: Which tracker it goes in. A tracker that is full holds a new quest back until it has room.

fields.name: action
fields.note: What to do. A client ignores any other value.

1.name: complete
1.note: Announce it done, or failed, for about four seconds, and take it from the tracker five seconds later.

2.name: remove
2.note: Take it from the tracker at once; a quest held back takes its place.

fields.name: flags

bits.name: first
bits.note: For activate, set to have the client report the pointer passing over the quest (QuestEvent).

bits.name: second
bits.note: For activate, set to show the quest arriving.

bits.name: succeeded
bits.note: For complete, set where the quest succeeded, clear where it failed; only success shows floating text.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Unused; a server writes zero.

fields.note: What a flag means depends on action.

fields.name: quest
fields.note: The quest's number, which QuestEvent returns.
